justification: Lawrence stays under center, Javonte keeps grinding at RB1, and Chase Brown's back in the flex where he belongs after last week's fumble-rule nonsense cost me a game I still think about. Kamara did his job when I needed him, but Breece Hall's the better back standing in front of me this Sunday and I'm not sentimental about a five-point gap just because Kamara showed up hurt once — that's not loyalty, that's just arithmetic, so Hall gets the nod at RB2 and Kamara eats this week from the bench. Cooper's got a Questionable next to his name and he's starting anyway over Washington — a guy who suits up banged up is worth more to me than a healthy body who hasn't proven a thing, that's just how I see it. Bernard, LaPorta, Bates, and the Seattle D earned their chairs and nobody's touching them. Nix and Coleman are both on a bye up in Denver, not a decision, just a calendar, and Murray's still Out — none of that's my problem this week since the family's covered everywhere it counts.
forum_post: Dumbledore. Quiet fella, doesn't say much, I respect that in a man — but quiet don't stop the clock Sunday. We show up, we play it straight, we count to six. Nothing personal, just business.
